english.title: Fail to wear a visible airport pass within a restricted area of Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse or having first obtained the permission of Heathrow Airport Limited, being other than a bona fide airline passenger, failed to wear a pass issued to you by or on behalf of the Company so that it was reasonably visible at all times, while in a Restricted Area of Heathrow Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.18 and 2.1 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
